title: DemandCalculation
description: Settings that drive the weekly base rate and the weekly trend curve for every article in a store.

salesAverageWindowInWeeks.title: Sales Average Window
salesAverageWindowInWeeks.description: Complete weeks of sales the base rate averages over, in weeks. The same window one year earlier is the baseline the trend compares against, so the two always match.

trendWeeksAhead.title: Trend Weeks Ahead
trendWeeksAhead.description: How many coming weeks the published trend curve covers, in weeks, one factor per week. It must reach past the longest lead time plus the time to the next order.

minTrendFactor.title: Minimum Trend Factor
minTrendFactor.description: Lower clamp on a weekly trend factor, as a multiplier. No weekly trend factor is lower than this.

maxTrendFactor.title: Maximum Trend Factor
maxTrendFactor.description: Upper clamp on a weekly trend factor, as a multiplier. No weekly trend factor is higher than this.

minCategoryQuantityPerWindow.title: Minimum Category Quantity Per Window
minCategoryQuantityPerWindow.description: Sellable units a category must have sold in last year's baseline window, at a given level, before its trend is used there. Below it, the calculation moves up a level.
